coverage: 118 elements; 3383 nuclear ground states. Metastable states are excluded.
Atomic weights: CIAAW 2024 abridged values with uncertainties; — means no standard atomic weight. No isotope mass substituted.

Electron configurations: PubChem, with shell counts derived by expanding noble-gas cores and summing principal quantum numbers. Lawrencium uses NIST [Rn]5f14 7s2 7p1 rather than the older PubChem 6d1 assignment.
IAEA extraction date 2023-10-18; evaluation cutoff varies by isotope. Blank half-life never implies stable.
Half-life uncertainties use ENSDF last-digit notation; energy widths remain separate quantities; converted lifetimes are not displayed. Only up to three source decay modes are included.
Automated structural and scientific consistency checks passed; external teacher/scientist review pending.
